answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files a cedar-sealed behavior fingerprint. Each epoch a fresh sample must match its echo to the print; drift past an 8% ridge burns the bond. One script driving 1,000 copies leaves one shared echo, so one audit burns all bonds; a rented print cannot echo its renter. Filing costs 45 first, then 45+6(k-1) each; 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its bond.
